locations: Fully Remote; LA office / US remote
Marina del Rey, Los Angeles / US Remote
aestudio-aestudio:greenhouse:5616440004.description: AE Studio is a 160-person ML consultancy dedicated to solving the hardest problems in AI. We use our profits to fund research on the most important problems in AI Safety and Alignment. We partner with top researchers from both academia and industry, including Anthropic, Goodfire AI, Redwood, Princeton, MATS, RAND Corporation, and others. Our research is published in top ML conferences and currently deployed in safety-critical systems. AE Studio was founded 10 years ago with the goal of helping corporate clients develop humanity-affirming, agency-promoting technology. Since then we’ve developed a reputation for rapidly delivering world-class solutions to their hardest problems. We take the same client-centric approach to research, partnering with the world’s best external researchers to develop world-class results. They provide the vision and our researchers make their ideas a reality. Our core alignment team is 25 researchers and growing. We hire from all backgrounds. Whether you’re an independent researcher, an engineer, or an academic, AE is a place to make real impact on the single most important problem of our time. We research a diverse set of ambitious alignment directions that others neglect, including pretraining interventions for model safety, novel interpretability techniques, neuroscience-inspired approaches to alignment, and many others. You can learn more about our team and work from our Alignment Podcast as well as our research page . About the role You will be the person who makes the research acceleration model actually run. You own projects end to end: turning abstract research ideas into clear roadmaps, keeping technical teams unblocked and moving fast, and making sure progress is visible to leadership, collaborators, and funders. Projects usually involve several stakeholders, grants, or research partners, and some are internal research. You break down ambiguity, define milestones, and focus the team on what matters. You also dive in when something needs to be tested, validated, or unblocked. You identify dead ends early and keep work pointed at the highest-upside directions. And you're someone who could eventually lead a Skunkworks spinout, a new research track, or an internal product. About you Working knowledge of AI and ML systems, enough to track technical complexity and ask the right questions Experience managing complex technical projects, including research You can structure execution across ambiguous, high-stakes efforts You translate fluently between engineers, researchers, clients, and funders You take initiative without waiting for permission and own results end to end You care about AI alignment and believe meaningful progress on the problem is possible Eager to use AI tools and automate everything you can Comfortable in a fast-paced, startup-like environment Bonus Experience in AI research, technical product leadership, or startup founding Prior work with generative AI, large language models, or experimental architectures Background in DARPA-style research, grant-based work, or scientific pipelines Being in LA to work from our office Benefits Remote-first with flexible schedules. Coworking spaces available in the Bay Area and NYC. Platinum health insurance, free lunches at the office, weekly knowledge-sharing talks, and an annual team retreat. Regular performance-based raises and a diversified employee equity program. Compensation Salary range is $180K to $240K per year for US-based candidates. Not in the range? Apply anyway and may have other roles opening soon

getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:80f6eb3c-035.title: Founding Field & Events Marketer
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:80f6eb3c-035.description: Wing is seeking elite talent to join M32 AI (backed by top-tier Silicon Valley VCs), dedicated to building agentic AI for traditional service businesses. Think of it like a startup within a corporate: fast moving and agile, with the stability of a corporate, and zero bureaucracy. If you’re driven by challenge and eager to make a significant impact in a high-caliber role, this is the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. We're hiring a Field & Events Marketer to own our presence at industry events, tradeshows, and conferences across North America. You'll source the right shows, run them end to end, and be the person on the ground making sure every event drives real pipeline. This is a hands-on role for someone 1-4 years into their career who loves logistics, thrives in fast-paced environments, and gets a kick out of pulling off a great event. You'll partner closely with sales, marketing, and product to turn booth space and badge scans into meetings, opportunities, and closed revenue. Why This Role You'll own a high-visibility function from day one. Every event is a chance to shape how customers, prospects, and the industry see us. If you want to grow fast, take real ownership, and build a portfolio of events you're genuinely proud of, this is the seat for you.
responsibilities: Source and prioritize events. Research, evaluate, and recommend tradeshows, conferences, and industry events that align with our ICP and revenue goals. Own a rolling 12-month event calendar.
Negotiate and contract. Manage relationships with event organizers, vendors, and venues. Negotiate sponsorships, booth space, speaking slots, and add-ons to stretch every dollar.
Plan and execute end to end. Own every detail, including booth design and shipping, swag, collateral, lead capture, badge scanners, AV, catering, hotel blocks, and travel logistics for the team.
Be the on-site point of contact. Attend every event in person. Set up and tear down booths, troubleshoot in real time, and make sure our presence looks sharp from start to finish.
Prep the team. Brief attending team members on objectives, talking points, target accounts, and logistics. Make sure everyone knows where to be, when, and what to do.
Drive pipeline with sales. Partner with sales to book pre-show meetings, run dinners and customer events on-site, and ensure every lead is captured, qualified, and followed up on quickly.
Run pre- and post-event campaigns. Work with marketing on email outreach, landing pages, paid promotion, and social to drive booth traffic and meeting bookings before the show.
Own the budget. Manage event spend across the full calendar. Track costs, forecast accurately, flag risks early, and make smart trade-off decisions when priorities shift.
Define KPIs and report on results. Set clear KPIs for each event (leads, meetings, pipeline, ROI) and build clean post-event reports that show what worked, what didn't, and how to improve next time.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:97d5ad0a-4f58-.title: Engineering Manager, Identification Accuracy
jobgether-jobgether:lever:97d5ad0a-4f58-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Engineering Manager, Identification Accuracy based in United Arab Emirates. This is a high-impact engineering leadership role at the intersection of machine learning, data science, and fraud prevention. You will lead a multidisciplinary team responsible for improving the accuracy and reliability of a critical identification platform. The role combines people leadership, technical strategy, and hands-on program direction in a globally distributed, fully remote environment. You’ll shape the team roadmap and guide the development of production ML systems operating at massive scale. Working closely with engineering, product, and customer-facing teams, you’ll translate business needs into meaningful technical priorities. This is an opportunity to influence both the technology and the people behind a best-in-class fraud detection capability. Lead and grow a multidisciplinary Identification Accuracy team spanning ML engineers, data scientists, analysts, and analytics engineers, fostering psychological safety, technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement. Own the team’s technical roadmap in collaboration with senior engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, identifying opportunities to improve model quality and address complex identification challenges. Drive measurable model accuracy outcomes by enabling the team to design, train, evaluate, and deploy machine learning models that improve identification performance across billions of devices. Oversee the delivery of production ML systems across data pipelines, feature engineering, model development, evaluation, and deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability. Partner closely with platform and API engineering teams to understand downstream requirements, performance expectations, and latency constraints. Collaborate with Product and customer-facing teams to translate customer needs and business priorities into technical initiatives and product improvements. Communicate model performance, data-quality considerations, technical trade-offs, risks, and roadmap priorities clearly to both technical teams and senior business stakeholders. Build a high-performing, multidisciplinary organization by mentoring team members, developing technical leaders, and creating an environment where people can do their best work. Continuously improve engineering and ML practices, including experimentation, model evaluation, MLOps, data workflows, and operational processes. Requirements 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering, machine learning, data science, or a related technical discipline, including at least 2 years leading an ML or data science team in a fast-paced environment. Proven experience managing technical teams that deliver production machine learning systems, from data pipelines and feature engineering through model training, evaluation, and deployment. Demonstrated success building and developing high-performing multidisciplinary teams that include engineers, data scientists, analysts, or analytics engineers. Strong technical understanding of machine learning and data systems, with familiarity with MLOps practices and tooling such as experiment tracking, feature stores, model registries, and ML CI/CD pipelines. Experience working with large-scale behavioral or event data in production environments. Hands-on familiarity with data stack and analytics engineering technologies such as dbt or similar tools. Ability to work effectively with platform and API engineering teams and understand technical requirements, system dependencies, and latency constraints. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex model behavior, data-quality challenges, and technical trade-offs for both technical and non-technical audiences. Demonstrated ability to deliver results in rapidly scaling

jobgether-jobgether:lever:ab9e7b72-6158-.title: Property Management Account Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:ab9e7b72-6158-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Property Management Account Manager based in South Africa. This is a fully remote opportunity for an experienced property management professional to take ownership of a diverse portfolio and its day-to-day operations. You’ll serve as a key point of contact for clients and tenants, building strong relationships while ensuring properties are managed efficiently. The role combines operational oversight, communication, team coordination, and independent problem-solving. You’ll be expected to navigate complex situations that may not have straightforward answers, using sound judgment and a proactive mindset. Starting with a portfolio of around 100 units, you’ll have the opportunity to scale toward 150, 200, or more units as your performance grows. It’s an ideal environment for an adaptable, resilient professional who thrives on responsibility, fast-paced work, and continuous improvement. Serve as the primary point of contact for client and tenant communications, managing relationships professionally and ensuring timely, effective responses. Oversee the day-to-day operations of an assigned property portfolio, maintaining high standards of service and operational performance. Manage a portfolio that may range from approximately 70 units for standard performers to 350 units for top performers. Handle daily communication workflows, primarily through written correspondence and email, with occasional outbound phone calls. Take ownership of portfolio growth, with an initial target of approximately 100 units and the opportunity to scale to 150, 200, or more units based on performance. Coordinate workflows and oversee team performance, including supervising, guiding, and holding Virtual Assistants accountable. Identify and resolve unusual or complex operational issues that may fall outside established procedures, manuals, or FAQs. Apply critical thinking, initiative, and sound judgment to determine appropriate solutions in ambiguous situations. De-escalate conflicts with clients and tenants calmly and professionally while maintaining positive relationships. Adapt quickly to changing priorities and operational demands while maintaining a high level of service and attention to detail. Requirements: Previous professional experience in property management, particularly as a Leasing Agent, Property Management Assistant, Property Manager, or in a comparable property operations position. Demonstrated ability to oversee daily property operations, workflows, and team performance. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with confidence managing clients, tenants, and team members. Experience supervising, guiding, delegating to, and holding Virtual Assistants or remote team members accountable. Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving abilities, with the confidence to make sound decisions when situations are complex or solutions are not explicitly documented. Highly adaptable and resourceful, with a proactive, self-directed, and autodidactic approach to learning and problem-solving. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced operational environment. Calm and professional approach to conflict resolution, with resilience and a consistently positive attitude. Availability to work U.S. business hours. A quiet, dedicated home-office environment suitable for professional calls and focused work. Reliable internet connection of at least 10 Mbps, with a backup internet connection available. Dependable electricity with a suitable power backup solution. Computer with at least an Intel Core i5 8th generation processor, AMD Ryzen 5, or equivalent. At least 8 GB of RAM, with 16 GB or more preferred. Windows 10 or higher or a compatible recent version of macOS. Benefits: Fully remote position, allowing you to work from your home office in Slovenia. Opportunity to manage

jobgether-jobgether:lever:d1479e1b-f2e9-.title: Director of Marketing
jobgether-jobgether:lever:d1479e1b-f2e9-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Marketing based in Norway. This is a senior, commercially minded marketing leadership role focused on turning brand awareness into measurable revenue and scalable growth. You will own the full marketing strategy across acquisition, conversion, retention, lifecycle, brand, content, and community. As a player-coach, you will lead the Marketing team while staying close to performance data, creative execution, and optimization. You will work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to support growth and expansion into new markets. The role combines strategic ownership with hands-on execution in a fast-moving, high-growth environment. You will also build the systems, playbooks, and processes needed to scale marketing efficiently across multiple locations. This is an opportunity for a bold, data-driven leader who knows how to build a memorable brand while delivering strong commercial results. Own and evolve the overall marketing strategy across growth, lifecycle, brand, content, and community, translating company growth and revenue objectives into clear priorities, budgets, KPIs, and measurable outcomes. Lead marketing analytics and reporting, maintaining clear visibility into channel performance, customer behavior, acquisition, conversion, retention, and lifetime value. Develop a deep understanding of target customers and use behavioral insights to improve the full customer journey from discovery through purchase, repeat visits, and advocacy. Own profitable customer acquisition and ticket sales across markets, overseeing paid media, SEO, and other growth channels while driving continuous testing and optimization of CAC, ROAS, conversion, and LTV. Oversee e-commerce and digital conversion performance, including landing pages, offers, booking journeys, mobile experiences, and checkout. Build repeatable marketing playbooks for launching and scaling new locations, working closely with Operations to align marketing investment with ticket inventory, seasonality, and market performance. Identify and test new channels, audiences, offers, partnerships, and creative concepts to unlock additional growth opportunities. Own retention and loyalty initiatives across email, SMS, memberships, referrals, reactivation, and other lifecycle programs designed to increase repeat visits, frequency, and customer lifetime value. Use segmentation and customer insights to create relevant, personalized communications and partner with Customer Experience to translate feedback into improvements. Protect and evolve the brand as the business expands, leading content, social, creator, influencer, PR, community, and local activation strategies. Develop campaigns and experiences that generate genuine participation, conversation, sharing, and advocacy across markets. Lead, coach, and develop the Marketing team while maintaining hands-on involvement in execution and performance optimization. Manage agencies, freelancers, and external partners, setting clear expectations and holding them accountable for measurable results. Establish the right balance of internal and external capabilities as the marketing function scales. Build efficient systems, reporting structures, processes, and playbooks that allow Marketing to support significantly more locations without proportional headcount growth. Recruit and develop high-performing marketing talent and establish strong collaboration across Marketing, Operations, Sales, Customer Experience, Technology, and Expansion. Balance long-term brand building with the immediate commercial priorities of a rapidly growing business. Requirements 8+ years of progressive marketing experience, including experience leading, coaching, and developing a marketing team. Proven experience in a consumer-facing, multi-location, DTC, e-commerce, wellness, hospitality, or experience-led business.

qualdoc-qualdoc:lever:d1d328b1-47b2-4542.description: Strategic Procurement Manager Location: Columbus, OH Job Type: Full-Time Direct Hire Starting Salary: $100,000/year (higher compensation available based on experience) Position Summary We are seeking a Strategic Procurement Manager to lead purchasing and supplier development activities within a manufacturing environment supporting electrical power distribution products. This role will oversee sourcing strategies, supplier relationships, material availability, and cost improvement initiatives for fabricated and purchased components. The ideal candidate has experience purchasing materials such as copper bar stock, sheet metal, fabricated parts, and electrical components within an OEM, contract manufacturing, or power distribution environment. Background in power systems, power distribution equipment, electrical equipment manufacturing, OEM, or contract manufacturing

Strong supplier negotiation and relationship-management skills
Experience developing and qualifying new suppliers

Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities
